info.title: Seller Search Creator on Marketplace
info.description: This API is used by Sellers to search for Creators in the Creator Marketplace. Sellers can search based on filters such as GMV, keywords, and Creator follower demographics. All the data returned is for the last 30 days.

post.description: This API is used by Sellers to search for Creators in the Creator Marketplace. Sellers can search based on filters such as GMV, keywords, and Creator follower demographics. All the data returned is for the last 30 days.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination offset determines where you begin to search for. It's empty when raise your first request

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The value of "page_size" must be 12 or 20

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

search_key.description:
Caching search results improves api performance and ensures stable request results.
You don't need to pass a value on the first call. 
For the second call, please pass the value returned in the response of the first call.

keyword.description: Searching creators by keyword, matching based on TikTok Username and Nickname.

age_ranges.description:
Follower age filtering options, which are range intervals, include: 
AGE_RANGE_18_24: "18-24", 
AGE_RANGE_25_34: "25-34", 
AGE_RANGE_35_44: "35-44", 
AGE_RANGE_45_54: "45-54", 
AGE_RANGE_55_AND_ABOVE: "55+"

count_ge.description:
The minimum value of follower count. 
The value passed in must be greater than or equal to 0

count_le.description:
The maximum value of follower count. 
- Generally, a value greater than or equal to 0 needs to be passed. If a value less than 0 is passed, it means that the field will not be filtered.

percentage_ge.description:
Greater than or equal to a certain percentage, scaled up by 10,000 times. 
For example, 6000 stands for 0.6 or 60%

gender_distribution.description: Filtering creators by follower gender which includes: "male", "female"

gmv_ranges.description:
Filtering by GMV range intervals which include: 
GMV_RANGE_0_100: "0-100", 
GMV_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
GMV_RANGE_1000_10000: "1000-10000", 
GMV_RANGE_10000_AND_ABOVE: "10000+"
For example: 
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.
- If GMV_RANGE_0_100 and GMV_RANGE_100_1000 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 1000.

units_sold_ranges.description:
Filtering by sales volume range intervals which include: 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10: "0-10", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100: "10-100", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_100_1000: "100-1000", 
UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_1000_AND_ABOVE: "1000+"
For example: 
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 is passed, it means filtering the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 10.
- If UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_0_10 and UNITS_SOLD_RANGE_10_100 are passed, it means to filter the creator data that is greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 100.

parent_category_id.description: Category of the parent category. If you are only using a parent category, you do not need to pass in a child category ID.

child_category_id_list.description: If you are using the category ID for a child category, you must pass the parent category as well. A child category is only 1 level deeper than the parent category. We do not support going deeper down the category tree (some countries have 4 levels, others have 7)

avg_video_views.description:
Average Video Views more than
You can pass in average video views anywhere between 0 and 100k
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in Average Video Views OR Average Shoppable Video Views. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail.

avg_shoppable_video_views.description:
You can pass in average shoppable video views anywhere between 0 and 100k
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average shoppable video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in Average Video Views OR Average Shoppable Video Views. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail.

avg_engagement_rate.description:
Average engagement rate more than 0-20.
You can only filter by increments of 1% point, up to 20%.

avg_shopable_engagement_rate.description:
Average shoppable engagement rate more than 0-20.
You can only filter by increments of 1% point, up to 20%.

avg_live_avg_viewers_ge.description:
Average LIVE views greater than or equal to
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in average LIVE or average shoppable LIVE. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail

avg_shoppable_live_avg_viewers_ge.description:
Average shoppable LIVE viewers greater than or equal to
Pick any whole number between 0 and 100,000, and we will return all results with average video views greater than that number.
You can only pass in average LIVE or average shoppable LIVE. Using both filters will cause the API call to fail

avg_commission_rate.description:
- ALL
- LESS_THAN_20%
- LESS_THAN_15%
- LESS_THAN_10%
- LESS_THAN_5%
Creator's average commission rate range based on showcase products, sales, and promoted products in the last 30 days.
You can only pick one value.

post_rate.description:
These categories represent how often a creator posts a shoppable video or LIVE after receiving a sample.
- All 
- OK 
- GOOD 
- BETTER
Every country has its own benchmark based on what is a GOOD vs BETTER fulfillment rate. BETTER is always going to have the highest fulfillment rate, including 100% fulfillment rate.

is_fast_growing.description: Top 10% of creators with the greatest increase in transactions, revenue, shoppable videos, live views, or followers in the last 30 days

not_invited_l90_days.description:
True/False
Select this filter to see creators you haven't invited in the last 90 days

affiliate_data.description: Object which contains affiliate based data

eligible_flat_fee.description: Creator is eligible for flat fee invitation, only available in US local seller

name.description: Option name, used if the option has sub-type choices.

option_list.description: Creator Marketplace Advanced Filter Option List. Please use "Get Seller Search  Creator Marketplace Advanced Filters"(https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-seller-search-creator-marketplace-advanced-filters) get available options for you first

sorter_algorithm_id.description: Sorter algorithm id. Please use "Get Seller Search  Creator Marketplace Advanced Filters"(https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/get-seller-search-creator-marketplace-advanced-filters) get available sorter algorithm for you first. Default is 1(default sorter)

advanced_filters.description: Advanced filters are specific to each country. We will provide a separate endpoint which allows you to query which filters are available for which country.

data_groups.description:
Creator's Data Group, get all group by default, which include: 
- BASIC_CREATOR_INFORMATION
- CONTENT_PERFORMANCE
- FOLLOWER_INFORMATION
- COLLABORATION
- SALES_AND_GMV

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

search_key.description: Caching search results improves api performance and ensures stable request results

selection_region.description: Regions where the creator operates and promotes products

category_ids.description: It indicates the main product categories when the creator posts products.

avg_ec_live_uv.description: Average UV for creator's e-commerce live streams

avg_ec_video_view_count.description: Average views for creator's e-commerce videos

gmv.description:
Creator GMV-related information
If the creator does not authorize sharing precise data, this will be omitted.

live_gmv.description:
Live stream GMV
If the creator does not authorize sharing precise data, this will be omitted.

video_gmv.description:
Video GMV-related information
If the creator does not authorize sharing precise data, this will be omitted.

minimum_amount.description: The minimum value of GMV range

maximum_amount.description: The maximum value of GMV range

formatted_range.description: The formatted range of GMV values associated with this creator.

gmv_range.description:
GMV range.
Applicable if the target market is the US and the creator does not authorize sharing precise data.

minimum_amount.description: The minimum value of sales volume range

maximum_amount.description: The maximum value of sales volume range

formatted_range.description: The formatted range of minimum number of units sold to maximum number of units sold over the lifetime of the creator account.

units_sold_range.description: The range of minimum number of units sold to maximum number of units sold over the lifetime of the creator account. Note that this property is included if the target market is US only. Note that if the creator has not given permission for precise data sharing, these properties will not be present.

age_ranges.description:
Return the top 3 age ranges of the followers. Ranges are :
AGE_RANGE_18_24: "18-24", 
AGE_RANGE_25_34: "25-34", 
AGE_RANGE_35_44: "35-44", 
AGE_RANGE_45_54: "45-54", 
AGE_RANGE_55_AND_ABOVE: "55+"

gender.description: Top follower gender category of the creator, "MALE" or "FEMALE"

percentage.description:
Percentage of top follower gender, scaled up by 10,000 times. 
For example, 6524 stands for 0.6524 or 65.24%. You can then infer that the opposite gender would be 0.3476 or 34.76%.

top_follower_demographics.description: Top follower information of the creator

is_official_recommend.description: Creator has official recommend tag or not

is_fast_growing.description: Creator has fast growing tag or not

has_collaborated.description: Has collaborated with this creator or not

user_type_tag.description:
User type tag.
-1 privacy creator
-2 carve out creator

is_creator_blocked.description: Is this creator blocked by shop or not

pps_score.description: Creator promotion performance score(PPS).The score reflects the quality of a creator's shoppable content and product selection over the past 30 days. A high score may indicate a better shopping experience, with fewer potential refunds or negative reviews. e.g. 4.3/5.0

is_eligible_flat_fee.description: Is creator eligible for flat fee, only available for US local seller

is_rising_star.description: Creator has rising star tag or not

creator_profile.description: Advanced creator profile infomation. If we return an empty object, it means this filter is not currently supported by your account or region.
